basics.name: Guilherme Vigneron de Oliveira
basics.label: Principal Technologist | Quality, DevOps & Developer Experience
basics.summary: Principal Technologist with 18+ years of experience advancing software quality, engineering velocity, and developer experience. Grounded in quality engineering and automation, my work spans DevOps, software development, daily AI/LLM engineering workflows, and company-wide DX Snapshots that turn org-wide feedback into action.

work.name: AVEVA
highlights: Organized company-wide Developer Experience (DX) Snapshots and analyzed org-wide results to uncover engineering bottlenecks and inform priorities.
Expanded into DevOps and software development, building CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and engineering deliverables in Azure DevOps.
Integrated LLMs and AI-assisted workflows into daily engineering to accelerate development, testing, and data analysis while maintaining quality.
Led comprehensive test strategies and robust Selenium/C# automation frameworks, increasing test coverage and reducing defects.
Conducted critical performance testing to optimize software scalability and reliability.
Led cross-functional teams as a Scrum Master, fostering collaboration and driving sustained sprint delivery.

work.name: AVEVA
highlights: Headed the development of test strategies, increasing test coverage and reducing defects.
Designed a robust Page Object Model test framework using Selenium and C#.
Orchestrated testing processes using Azure DevOps release pipelines.
Mentored junior QA engineers, improving team productivity and knowledge sharing.

work.name: AVEVA
highlights: Led the implementation of a risk-based testing approach, prioritizing test cases based on business impact.
Pioneered the implementation of new test automation tools.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to optimize the software development lifecycle.
Developed and delivered comprehensive training programs on testing techniques for QA analysts.

projects.name: guilhermevigneron.dev
projects.subtitle: Self-Verifying Portfolio & Resume Pipeline
projects.description: Zero-third-party static showcase driven by a single resume.json source of truth. Compiles fingerprinted bundles, Schema.org JSON-LD, llms.txt, vCard, Open Graph card, and A4 /resume.pdf, gated by HTML5 validation, Playwright mobile Web Vitals budgets, and 16-audit WCAG 2.1 AA Cypress + axe checks.
highlights: Enforces strict default-src 'self' CSP with SHA-256 asset fingerprinting, subsetted Geist fonts, and responsive AVIF/WebP imagery.
Publishes live CI telemetry to /quality/ and /quality/report.json alongside weekly production smoke and link-rot checks.

The Big Picture: Defining a Successful Test Automation Strategy

awards.title: AVEVA Innovation and Creativity Recognition Award
awards.summary: Awarded for turning an idea into a working prototype at CanAms Hackathon 2025, finishing 4th place out of ~41 ideas.
